meta.title: WeChat data and read-only archive
meta.description: Choose a directory in the native conversation, then scan to connect your own WeChat. Confirmed pairing enables automatic text replies. Chat and model selection stay native; source and recovery controls are collapsed. File upload needs separate consent.

task.nativeModelLoading: Loading the native session model list…
task.nativeModelUnavailable: The native session model list is unavailable. Check the current session.
task.firstNewInputHint: Keep the prior reply record and prepare a separate source-free test for new phone text. The old permission remains spent.
task.firstNewInputConsent: Keep the old record and allow one new source-free text test, with at most one model request and one reply to my WeChat
task.firstNewInputAllowed: The new text test is allowed. Review its scope and confirm this model permission and WeChat sharing.
task.updatesDiagnosticHint: Read WeChat updates once and inspect field shapes and counts. Keep the cursor, queue and Task history. No model request or reply is sent. This diagnostic is independent of sharing and history permits.
task.updatesDiagnosticConsent: Allow one WeChat update read for this diagnostic
task.title: WeChat assistant
task.guide: Choose the conversation directory, scan your own WeChat, and enable automatic text replies
task.intro: Request tasks from your phone and see progress and results in the same native DSH conversation.
task.nativeHint: Connect WeChat here and use the same model selector as the conversation input.
task.localCapabilities: Owner image/document return is implemented: at most four declared files per turn, 10 MiB each. Phone acceptance still requires authorization. Arbitrary commands remain unavailable.
task.archiveSeparate: The archive keeps its own entry. Ordinary data-sidebar grants never move to a task automatically.
task.launcher: Open the assistant beside the current conversation
task.restoreSession: Open the assistant for this conversation
task.noSessions: No native conversation is available. Use the native workspace controls.
task.selectionChanged: The conversation changed; the old opening request was cancelled.
task.opening: Waiting for the current native conversation sidebar…
task.navigationUnavailable: The native sidebar is not ready. No other conversation was created or selected.
task.workspaceHint: Choose an existing workspace or directory. Confirmation creates an independent task without inheriting current sources or tools.
task.workspaceImmutable: The task workspace is fixed. Create a new task to change it; reauthorization changes its source generation.
task.workspaceConsent: Allow workspace reads, controlled text creation/edits, and task-directed image/document selection. No automatic upload, arbitrary commands, or access outside the directory.
task.sourceSharing: Allow my WeChat to receive content using this source. Whole-task sharing and starting the channel still require separate consent.
task.directoryHint: Extra directories are read-only. Credentials, original WeChat files, databases, and link targets are denied.
task.directoryConsent: Allow controlled text reads and task-directed image/document selection here. Text and selected file metadata may reach the model provider and task history; file upload needs separate WeChat sharing consent.
task.sessionHint: Bind only this exact conversation. System, tool, reasoning, media, and unknown-producer messages are omitted.
task.sessionConsent: Allow the task model to read user and completed assistant text from this conversation, send it to its provider, and retain it in task history.
task.archiveImportUnavailable: Automatic import and decryption are not delivered. This advanced entry accepts an existing independent plaintext copy; it never reads originals or keys or makes manual decryption a normal user prerequisite.
task.archivePathAdvanced: Advanced: use an existing copy path
task.archivePathHint: Select a prepared independent WeChat history copy.
task.rosterConsent: Allow this UI to read contact names and identities from this copy for my scope selection only, without model message access.
task.dateHint: Includes each selected day in this computer’s timezone. Empty means unbounded. Changing contacts or dates clears consent.
task.archiveConsent: Allow the task model to read messages for these contacts and dates, send them to its provider, and retain them in native task history.
task.previewHint: Queries run only when clicked. Previews never submit model input; revocation still conservatively blocks old-source context.
task.pathHint: Absolute paths, parent traversal, database and credential files are denied.
task.chooseContact: Choose a contact; search may cover the granted scope
task.directoryTruncated: Directory display reached its limit. Specify a subdirectory or text file.
task.rowsTruncated: This page was budget-limited; page using the actual returned rows.
task.authorizationUnknown: A source or sharing outcome is unknown. Refresh and other-source grants cannot resolve it. Explicitly regrant that source or revoke all task sources.
task.contextBlocked: Existing context sharing has not been restored. Regrant the required sources and confirm whole-task WeChat sharing to check recovery. Missing sources or unknown history still block automatic replies.
task.sourcesHint: Use only individually authorized workspaces, directories, exact DSH conversations, and WeChat archives. A checked box is not a server grant result.
task.sourceShareAllowed: This source may be used for my WeChat
task.sourceShareDenied: WeChat sharing denied for this source
task.revokeAll: Revoke all task sources and stop channel
task.sharingHint: Checks all consumed sources. After regranting, this confirmation also covers existing replies from earlier source grants. Enabling sharing does not start communication.
task.consumedHint: This task has used sources. Revocation does not delete history, make the model forget, or retract received data.
task.wholeContextConsent: Allow my WeChat to receive replies derived from this task’s entire existing and future context and its explicitly declared images/documents. Files are uploaded to the WeChat CDN. All consumed sources need current grants that allow sharing.
task.denySharing: Disable task sharing and stop channel
task.deliveryProgress: API accepted {accepted}/{total} items in this turn; this is not a phone receipt.
task.deliveryPending: Remaining items have not been dispatched.
task.deliveryUncertain: The current dispatch is active or uncertain; do not resend.
task.historyHint: Use only this task's recorded context. No new source reads, file writes, or attachments. History approval, sharing, and the model/WeChat call require separate confirmations.
task.historyScope: Task: {sessionId}; fixed workspace: {root}; consumed workspace generations: {count}. This does not prove old files still exist or are unchanged.
task.historyApprovalConsent: Allow this task to process one Owner text input using only its recorded history with the current model provider. Do not restore source read/write permissions.
task.historyApproved: Historical text approved; WeChat sharing is not confirmed.
task.historySharingConsent: Allow my WeChat to receive one plain-text reply derived from this approved history. No continuous polling or attachments.
task.historySharingConfirmed: This historical share is confirmed. The single model/WeChat call still needs its own confirmation.
task.historyRunConsent: Allow one Owner text input, at most one model request, and one plain-text WeChat reply. Empty, failed, or cancelled attempts consume the permit without automatic retries.
task.historySdkRequired: No usable recorded-request seal is available in the native SDK. Refuse rather than fall back to ordinary directory assembly.
task.historyUnsupportedSources: Version 1 supports only consumed history from this fixed workspace. Other sources cannot be partially restored.
task.historyUnavailable: Historical proof or state is not verified. This status query does not read sources or call a model or WeChat.
task.historyNotRequired: No workspace history needs reauthorization. Ordinary task access remains strict.
task.historyExpired: The review or permit expired. Review again; no automatic renewal.
task.historyChanged: Sources, native context, or permissions changed. Old confirmations cannot be reused.
task.historyAuditUnknown: Audit outcome is unknown. Check matching receipts; refresh or source revocation cannot erase it.
task.historyRunUnknown: Model or WeChat outcome is unknown. Revocation does not prove no request or send occurred. Do not retry.
task.historyAccepted: Permit consumed and sharing closed. WeChat API accepted one text; this is not a phone receipt.
task.historyEmpty: No reply in this attempt. Permit consumed, sharing closed, and no further poll scheduled.
task.historyReceiptCounts: Recorded execution receipt: model requests reserved {model}; WeChat API accepted {accepted}; outcome {outcome}; audit {audit}.
task.firstHint: Use only the fixed SDK safety instruction and this one human text. No workspace data or previous messages. This never enables ordinary sharing.
task.firstScope: Task: {sessionId}; workspace identity only: {root}. No directory access or source content is granted.
task.firstApprovalConsent: Allow this one human text to reach this Task's explicitly selected model, without sources or previous messages.
task.firstApproved: First-text permit approved; WeChat sharing is not confirmed.
task.firstSharingConsent: Allow my WeChat to receive one plain-text reply under this first-text permit.
task.firstSharingConfirmed: First-text sharing confirmed; the single call still needs its own confirmation.
task.firstRunConsent: Allow one owner text read, at most one logical model request and one unsplit plain-text WeChat send. Empty, failed or cancelled attempts consume the permit; no automatic retries.
task.firstRun: Read and reply to one first text
task.firstRevoke: Revoke first text and stop sharing
task.firstModelHint: Shares model selection with the conversation input.
task.firstModelPreparationConsent: Allow preparation of this selected model's metadata and private authentication with the declared effects. No generation or source access.
task.firstModelEffects: Preparation effects — filesystem: {filesystem}; credentials: {credentials}; network: {network}; cache: {cache}
task.firstSdkRequired: The native SDK first-text capability is unavailable. No ordinary preparation or warmup fallback.
task.firstAdapterUnsupported: This adapter cannot prove restricted preparation and connection/authentication generations. Choose a supported model; execution stays closed.
task.firstModelMissing: The Task model is not selected or safely prepared. No model request was made.
task.firstNotEmpty: The complete native model context is not provably empty. First-text execution is unavailable; do not clear history to create eligibility.
task.firstStale: The native or model observation changed. Old reviews and confirmations cannot be reused.
task.firstPrepFailed: Selected-model preparation failed or was cancelled. No usable execution permit was created.
task.firstUnavailable: First-text state has not been verified. Reading status does not read sources, prepare credentials or call a model or WeChat.
task.selectionHint: Selecting or clearing a task neither changes the center, transfers grants, nor stops another task’s channel.
task.knownIdHint: If an existing task is absent from the catalogue, enter its original ID. This only selects a target; explicit verification and reuse is still required. No creation, pairing copy, restored sources, sharing or communication.
task.knownIdInvalid: Enter a complete wechat-task- v4 ID, not an ordinary Session, path or account identity.
task.taskSubsystemUnavailable: Required native task services are absent. No alternative executor was loaded.
task.creationUnknown: Creation or workspace grant outcome is unknown. Check existing tasks before creating another.
task.noTask: No task selected. Choose an existing task or explicitly grant a workspace to create one.
task.resumeTaskHint: Verify and reuse this exact task only. No creation, network, or restored source, sharing, or channel permissions.
task.localHistoryHint: Import the signed-in account history, then search from your bot conversation. Existing authenticated keys are reused.
task.localHistoryAuto: Check before searches and every minute
task.localHistoryConsent: Allow a private copy of my WeChat history for this task to search, read and write text in its current directory, and reply to my paired WeChat; updates use the same account and grant.
task.localHistoryauthenticating: Complete authentication in the system prompt…
task.localHistoryFailed: History update failed. The previous valid copy is retained. Check that WeChat is signed in, then retry.
task.localHistoryClientRequired: Open and sign in to one desktop WeChat client on this Linux computer running DSH, then retry.
task.dailyNoTodos: No explicit unfinished tasks in these records.
task.dailyPartial: Partial text review. Expand citations to read originals.
task.dailyWaiting: Import WeChat history to show data.
task.dailyFailed: Card update failed. The previous result is retained. Select Update cards to retry.
task.dailyFailedTruncated: The summary hit the model's output limit. The previous result is retained; it will retry at the next daily time or when you select Update cards.
task.dailyFailedModel: The summary model returned no result. The previous result is retained. Check that the model selected for this conversation is available.
task.dailyFailedEmpty: The model returned no content. The previous result is retained. Select Update cards to retry.
task.dailyFailedUnavailable: No model route is available for the summary. Choose a model in the conversation first.
task.dailyFailedCitation: The summary cited a record that is not in the batch, so this result was discarded. Select Update cards to retry.
task.dailyNoReport: Waiting for the daily time or the first report.
task.dailyScheduleHint: Beijing time, reviewing the previous day. Missed dates are caught up after reconnecting.
task.dailySourceEmptyHint: Choose another source or report date. This summary covers only the included text records.
task.historySourceFailed: Could not read this source. Retry or import WeChat history again.
task.historyEmptyHint: Try another keyword. Import history again to add the new sources.
task.historyMiniScope: Mini-program cards, titles, links and extracted text from chats and favorites.
task.historyFavoritesScope: Favorite content and origin. Dates use the favorite database update time.
task.historyContactsScope: Contact remarks, display names and WeChat IDs.
task.historyVoiceScope: Transcribe a selected voice locally. The next history update adds its text to search.
task.historyModelVision: Use the current model to understand selected images and video frames
task.historyTranscriptCitation: View voice record and transcript citation
task.historyMediaScope: Reads locally downloaded images and videos. Ask in the conversation to analyze a selected record; its image or frames are passed to the current model. Thumbnails are labeled.
task.historyAnalysisFailed: Could not analyze the selected media. Check its download, local runtime and media key.
task.historyBatchHint: Automatic history updates process local transcription, OCR and indexing in idle batches.
task.historyBatchProgress: Local batch index: {processed} processed, {skipped} unavailable records skipped.
task.dailyTrackedEmpty: Confirm a to-do lead to keep tracking it here.
task.localHistoryAccountChanged: The signed-in WeChat account changed. Automatic recovery stopped; confirm the account and import again.

hints.empty: No independent decrypted snapshot is available. This UI does not access the original WeChat directory or start decryption.
hints.error: Inspect the snapshot state in Settings; this UI never enables reads or modifies original WeChat files.
hints.unconfigured: This legacy page has no independent decrypted snapshot, so queries and export are unavailable. Original WeChat files were not read, scanned or counted. Open the WeChat data sidebar to restore the current native conversation and grant its own copy, without creating or switching to a dedicated WeChat Session.

archive.title: Which session holds what I need

session.title: What was said in this session

export.title: Turn the snapshot into agent-readable files
export.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable; download the file instead.

note.safety: Independent snapshots use mode=ro + PRAGMA query_only=ON. Original WeChat files are never read sources. This page does not log in or network. Current data grants do not permit WeChat sending; optional bot connections require a separately chosen target and explicit actions.
note.limits: Up to 500 rows per call; searches scan at most 3000 messages; bodies longer than 1200 characters are truncated.
note.disable: Disable the plugin in the plugin manager. This page only shows configuration and never edits the profile.
note.metadata: The original directory is text metadata, not a read path. The current data sidebar accepts only your explicitly granted independent decrypted copy. This page never edits the profile; revoking access does not erase submitted native conversation history.
note.tools: These legacy archive interface names are not tool switches. Data grants add no model-tool permissions to the current Session; wechat_archive remains restricted to bot Sessions prepared by this plugin. Bot login, pairing and messaging are explicit actions on a separate target.

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.reason: Open the WeChat data sidebar, then select or explicitly create a restricted target under Optional WeChat bridge before authorizing QR and pairing. The center stays unchanged. This legacy page generates no QR, makes no network calls and never starts messaging.
pairing.authorization: Pairing, sharing the selected bot target’s entire existing context, and starting or stopping messaging are separate sidebar actions. The current data Session is never shared with that target automatically. Disabled controls here do not imply that any target is paired or messaging.
